text:
maya: Heads up — surprise sprinkle near Embarcadero, streets already shiny. Anyone hitting major delays this morning? ☔️

alex: On the 8:45 ferry. Captain announced a slow cruise while they clear some wake debris. +10–15. Umbrella = lifehack.

sam: Caltrain held at 4th & King for a signal reset. No official delay on status page but people are standing.

devon: I left early and managed to dodge everything. Bringing an emergency donut box to the office in 20m for soggy commuters 🍩

jordan: Dev, you are a hero. Gluten-free option? 🙏

devon: yep GF pack in the blue bag. Also sticky note: take the back stairs, puddle-free route.

alex: For folks heading to Ferry Building, heads up — the ramp by the taxi stand is a mini-waterfall. Recommend slippery shoes.

ops-bot: Transit Alert: SF Ferry Service — minor delays on North Bay routes due to debris clearance. https://sfbayferrystatus.example/ (auto-posted)

maya: Thanks for the heads-up, ops-bot. If anyone needs a ride share from Embarcadero, ping me — I have 2 extra seats on my scooter (not ideal but fast).

sam: Might take you up on that if Caltrain stays stuck. DM incoming.

jordan: Quick poll — who’s coming in vs WFH today? React with :raising_hand: if coming in, :house: if WFH.

alex: :raising_hand: (soggy but motivated)

devon: :raising_hand: (donut errands)

sam: :house: waiting for delays to clear

maya: Office update: kitchen table near the windows has the donut box and a towel stash for wet umbrellas. Please dry umbrellas on the mat so the floor doesn’t become a slide.

alex: Also, FYI: Caltrain status thread shows crews are on it. ETA unclear but moving.

jordan: Thank you everyone — minor chaos, major camaraderie. See you (damp) soon. :sweat_smile:

maya: Closing thread: enjoy caffeine and donuts. Stay safe on slick stairs!
